parameters.content:
## 🔔 RuleSet Activation Notifier

**Déclenchement :**  
Spring Boot envoie un POST vers ce webhook à chaque activation de RuleSet.

**Payload reçu (JSON) :**
```json
{
  "event":               "RULESET_ACTIVATED",
  "ruleSetId":           42,
  "ruleSetName":         "Scoring Crédit v3",
  "tenantId":            7,
  "tenantName":          "Banque Alpha",
  "status":              "ACTIVE",
  "version":             3,
  "strategy":            "FIRST_MATCH",
  "activatedBy":         "admin@alpha.com",
  "activatedAt":         "2026-05-21T10:30:00",
  "tenantMemberEmails":  ["user1@alpha.com", "user2@alpha.com"],
  "tenantMemberEmailsCsv": "user1@alpha.com,user2@alpha.com"
}
```

**Config Spring Boot requise :**
```properties
n8n.webhook.enabled=true
n8n.webhook.url=http://localhost:5678/webhook/ruleset-activated
n8n.webhook.secret=raas_n8n_secret_2026_9xK!pL7@aQ
```

**Credential SMTP à créer dans n8n :**  
Settings → Credentials → New → SMTP  
Nom : `SMTP RaaS`  
Host : votre serveur SMTP (ex. smtp.gmail.com:587)
